sources.title: Government notice on commune-status decree
sources.publisher: Service d’information du Gouvernement du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: Government notice describes a 2026 commune-status decree but does not supply a verified 2019-to-current unit crosswalk. Locate the decree and official unit list before joining current authorities to census communes.

sources.title: Fichier des localités du 5e RGPH (2019)
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: Official 2019 locality population by sex and age, including source-noted estimates for security-affected places. Use the 2019 13-region/45-province/351-commune geography; do not relabel it as the 2025 17-region/47-province system. Recheck raw redistribution terms.

sources.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PCD (December 2024)
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
sources.reuse_note: December 2024 communal development-plan (PCD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Check the guide's current applicability and the chosen locality's legal planning authority; no local plan is implied.

sources.title: Guide méthodologique de planification locale: PRD (December 2024)
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances
sources.reuse_note: December 2024 regional development-plan (PRD) guide predates the 2025 territorial code and administrative reform. Do not equate a 2019 statistical region with a current planning body without legal crosswalk.

sources.title: Government notice on 30 July 2026 territorial competence-transfer decrees
sources.publisher: Service d’information du Gouvernement du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData location: 30 July 2026 official council notice reports competence and resource transfer decrees under law 024-2025/ALT. Signed decree texts, numbers, commencement and selected-area application are not acquired; this is not a plan or budget.

sources.title: Loi n°024-2025/ALT portant Code général des collectivités territoriales
sources.publisher: Assemblée législative de transition / Académie de Police du Burkina Faso
sources.reuse_note: Law no. 024-2025/ALT cover and parliamentary adoption were checked. The 114-page posted PDF is scanned; its article-level requirements and present applicability were not text-verified. Verify exact articles and current consolidated status before prescribing a planning index.

sources.title: MATM / CONAFIL local-finance publications
sources.publisher: Conseil national de la statistique / Ministère de l’Administration territoriale et de la Mobilité
sources.reuse_note: Official MATM/CONAFIL catalogue lists local-government budget forecasts and transferred-resource execution reports. Inspect each report body and local identifiers; a forecast is not an approved area budget or actual execution.

sources.title: Komsilga communal development-plan procurement notice
sources.publisher: Direction générale du contrôle des marchés publics et des engagements financiers
sources.reuse_note: Official 2025 procurement notice for preparing Komsilga's PCD. This is a lead to the planning process, not a completed or approved plan, local budget or implementation result. Verify current commune identity.

sources.title: Rapport national 2024 sur les plans locaux de développement
sources.publisher: Ministère de l’Économie et des Finances, DGDT
sources.reuse_note: National 2024 monitoring report on local development plans, published in 2025. It is a planning-system reference, not evidence that any selected commune's plan or budget was obtained or approved. Check any area-specific document separately.

sources.title: Disparités communales de la pratique contraceptive au Burkina Faso
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2015 outcome model, 2019 census covariates; August 2023 report
sources.reuse_note: This is a modelled 2015 outcome using 2019 census covariates, not 2019 contraceptive prevalence. Three ambiguous commune name matches were withheld; review the crosswalk and raw reuse terms.

sources.title: RGPH 2019 Volume 3: Mesure et cartographie de la pauvreté
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2018 household survey with 2019 census frame; Annexes 5-9 use RGPH 2019
sources.reuse_note: Volume 3 Annex 4 monetary-poverty values are small-area estimates combining EHCVM 2018 with 2019 census geography, not directly enumerated census poverty. Annexes 5-9 report distinct census measures. Two whole-city commune aggregates and four incomplete rows were withheld; recheck definitions, geography, and redistribution terms.

sources.title: Résultats du 5e RGPH: volume des tableaux statistiques
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: Official statistical-table volume has 581 identified table headings; 17 have selected adopted values, 11 have reviewed decisions without new adoption, and 553 await semantic review. Table II.10 fertility values conflict with the final report's prose and figure (AreaData evidence: burkina-faso-fertility-source-conflict-2026-09-25.md); do not adopt or reconcile them automatically. Inspect numeric columns, denominators and source versions; regional rates are not commune rates.

sources.title: INSD regional statistical yearbooks catalogue, including 2024 editions
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
reference_periods: 2023 and 2024 regional yearbook listings; individual coverage varies
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData location: official INSD regional yearbook catalogue lists 2024 and 2023 editions. Individual PDFs, numeric tables, terms and 2025 geography correspondence are not audited or adopted.

sources.title: Annuaire statistique national 2024
sources.publisher: Institut national de la statistique et de la démographie (INSD)
sources.reuse_note: INSD 2024 national yearbook contains regional and commune fiscal tables and source caveats. Reacquire the full PDF, check numeric columns and null-value notes, and reconcile historical geography before adoption.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022: Preliminary Report
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Bangladesh project, not newly discovered by AreaData. Recheck the current BBS page and exact report before acquisition; AreaData independent audit and redistribution-terms review are pending.

sources.title: Population and Housing Census 2022: District Community Series (64 workbooks)
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Bangladesh project, not newly discovered by AreaData. Verify each district workbook and local geography independently; AreaData audit and source-terms review are pending.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census age/sex and urban/rural table, governorate totals
geographic_levels: governorate totals; lower units remain unreviewed
sources.reuse_note: New specific COSIT 2024 age/sex PDF location within the previously identified catalogue. AreaData adopted only the 18 governorate totals and national row. Kit must independently review age bands, lower units, source-defined codes, 2024 boundary equivalence and reuse terms before its own adoption.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census electricity household table
sources.reuse_note: New official COSIT table. Electricity-source counts can overlap; the regular-responding-household denominator differs from the domestic-water table. Kit must audit its own source rows and geography; AreaData has no independent ACCEPT.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census water household table
sources.reuse_note: New official COSIT primary water source used at home table. Piped inside dwelling is not a drinking-water or safe-water measure; denominator and categories differ from electricity. Kit must audit independently.

sources.title: COSIT final results of the 2024 Population and Housing Census
sources.publisher: Iraq Commission of Statistics and GIS (COSIT)
sources.license_or_terms: CC BY 4.0 portal envelope; resource terms review pending
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: Iraq COSIT 2024 final census summary in the government open-data portal. AreaData checked 18 governorate rows and five numeric columns locally. Kit must independently audit its own acquisition, adjusted versus original population definitions, code/boundary matching and resource-specific terms before adoption.

sources.title: Republic of Iraq National Development Plan 2024-2028
sources.reuse_note: New official Ministry of Planning national plan location. AreaData checked cover, May 2024 publication page and one spatial-programme page; approval status and remaining pages are unverified. This is not a governorate plan, budget, actual execution or official evaluation. Kit must independently audit the original and terms.

sources.title: COSIT Iraq 2024 census table catalogue
sources.reuse_note: New COSIT official 2024 census table catalogue location. Thirty PDFs were listed; seven acquired by AreaData and two household-service tables locally adapted. Kit must independently audit acquisition, every table field, official geography, terms and adoption.

sources.title: Jordan DoS estimated population at end of 2025, Tables 2.2 and 2.3
geographic_levels: district/subdistrict table present but not adopted
sources.reuse_note: New official DoS January 2026 PDF location for end-2025 population estimates, distinct from the 2015 census and WDI midyear series. AreaData adopted only five printed count fields from Tables 2.2 and 2.3 after sums; Kit must independently acquire original, verify terms, all fields, codes and current boundary edition before its own adoption.

sources.title: Guide for Preparation of Governorate Strategic Development and Implementation Plans
sources.reuse_note: New official 2018 governorate strategic/implementation planning guide location. Search-indexed text refers to the 2015 decentralization law, so current applicability under 2021 and 2026 local-administration laws requires review. A guide is not an actual governorate plan or budget.

sources.title: Jordan Ministry of Local Administration 2021 Local Administration Law listing
geographic_levels: governorate and municipality legal framework to audit
sources.reuse_note: New official Ministry of Local Administration listing for Law No. 22 of 2021. AreaData did not review the full PDF or assign planning duties. Compare with the enacted but not-yet-effective Law No. 16 of 2026 and its transition provisions before adapting current governance.

sources.title: Planning and International Cooperation Law No. 10 of 2024
sources.publisher: Jordan Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation
sources.reuse_note: New specific official Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation text of Law No. 10 of 2024. It describes national methodologies and institutional roles; it does not prove an individual governorate plan, approval, budget or execution.

sources.title: Official Gazette listing of Local Administration Law No. 16 of 2026
sources.reuse_note: New official Gazette listing for Law No. 16 of 2026. Published 2026-09-10 with effectiveness 60 days after publication according to official Petra notice, so it was not yet effective on AreaData's 2026-09-26 check. Independently review full text, amendments, transition and later effective status before using.

sources.title: Jordan DoS Population and Housing Census 2015 table catalogue
sources.reuse_note: New specific official 2015 census table catalogue location. No individual 2015 table was acquired or adopted by AreaData in this pass. Inspect actual originals, fields, definitions and reuse terms; do not treat end-2025 estimates as census counts.

sources.title: Results of Population and Housing Census 2015
sources.publisher: Lao Statistics Bureau / UNFPA Lao PDR
sources.license_or_terms: Source-site public access terms; redistribution status reviewed per retained file
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Lao project, not newly discovered by AreaData. This is the detailed 2015 census, not published 2025 local census results. Recheck report and geography; AreaData independent audit is pending.

sources.title: Lao PDR Subnational Population Statistics 2024
sources.publisher: UNFPA / Lao Statistics Bureau, distributed by HDX
sources.reuse_note: Reused from the Kit Lao project, not newly discovered by AreaData. UNFPA/LSB 2024 population statistics distributed via HDX are not 2024 census counts; recheck definitions, geography and redistribution terms.

sources.title: GASTAT Population by Detailed Age Tableau view
sources.reuse_note: New specific official GASTAT Tableau table location with metadata code TTCENPOP0105. Age, region, governorate, nationality and gender dimensions are visible, but reference period, full row inventory and downloadable original were not verified. AreaData adopted no observation from this view. Kit must independently acquire and audit the table, codes, boundaries, terms and geographic coverage.

sources.title: Ministry of Health Statistical Yearbook 2022, Table 1-12
sources.reuse_note: Previously recorded AreaData source location, carried forward unchanged: Saudi Ministry of Health 2022 yearbook Table 1-12 cites GASTAT for the 2022 census population of 13 administrative regions. Its 2010–2021 columns are recalculated estimates, not census counts. Kit must independently audit direct GASTAT tables, geographic codes/boundaries, terms and adoption.

sources.title: IOM DTM Syria Population Mobility and Baseline Assessment, round 17
sources.publisher: International Organization for Migration, DTM Syria
geographic_levels: governorate report table; code and boundary matching unverified
sources.license_or_terms: IOM DTM terms restrict extraction and redistribution without prior written permission
sources.reuse_note: New public IOM DTM June 2026 Syria humanitarian-baseline report location, not a census. Its key-informant estimates and rounded mobility shares are unadopted by AreaData. IOM DTM terms require prior written permission for extraction and redistribution; obtain permission and independently audit meanings, geographic codes and boundaries before any numeric use. No raw report or values are transferred.

sources.title: Citizen Budget 2026, Syrian Ministry of Finance
geographic_levels: national; local-plan target mentioned, no governorate document
sources.reuse_note: New official Syrian Ministry of Finance 2026 citizen-budget PDF. AreaData checked cover and selected pages; page 50 targets preparation of 14 governorate development plans in 2026. It does not prove any local plan was completed or approved, nor supply a local budget, actual expenditure or official evaluation. Kit must independently review original, terms and current planning institutions.

sources.title: TÜİK ADNKS 2025 — favorite tables
sources.reuse_note: New AreaData source location: TÜİK 2025 annual ADNKS population register, not a decennial census. AreaData locally checks province/district totals, but Kit must audit its own acquisition, source fields, 2025 geography, reuse terms and adoption independently.

sources.title: UBOS NPHC 2024 subcounty profiles — Uganda-LGDP normalized extraction
sources.reuse_note: AreaData adapted Uganda-LGDP normalized UBOS 2024 census data. The original UBOS workbook was not present in the adapter source checkout; reacquire and verify official originals and scope, including APAA, before use. Independent AreaData audit is pending.

sources.title: Local Government Development Planning Guidelines, second edition
sources.reuse_note: AreaData inherited this NPA guidance location through Uganda-LGDP resources. Verify the exact edition, applicability and PDF before use; AreaData independent audit and redistribution-terms review are pending.

sources.title: NPA local government plan catalogue
sources.reuse_note: NPA local-government plan catalogue location only. Area-specific plans, dates, duplicates and content must be checked individually; no plan is assumed current or adopted in Kit.

sources.title: CSO 2004 census main report location
geographic_levels: governorate and district coverage to inspect
sources.reuse_note: New official CSO URL for a 2004 main report. AreaData acquisition returned HTTP 200 non-PDF content; no numbers adopted. Reacquire authentic original and verify its administrative epoch before any use.

sources.title: Yemen Local Authority Law No. 4 of 2000
sources.reuse_note: New parliament location for original Law No. 4 of 2000. A 40-page PDF was acquired, but current consolidated applicability, amendments and actual local plan status are unverified.

sources.title: Taiz Economic and Social Development Plan 2024-2026, English PDF
sources.publisher: Taiz Governorate Planning and International Cooperation Office
sources.reuse_note: New direct PDF of the Taiz planning office's 42-page English 2024-2026 plan. Page 4 explicitly limits scope to 17 named liberated districts, whereas the 2024 CSO yearbook has 23 Taiz district rows. Do not assign to the whole governorate or 2017 reference polygon without exact geography. Approval, adopted budget, expenditure and evaluation are unverified.

sources.title: Taiz planning office 2024 progress and 2025 priorities presentation
sources.publisher: Taiz Governorate Planning and International Cooperation Office
sources.reuse_note: New Taiz planning-office presentation location: 2024 implementation/ongoing counts and 2025 priorities under a 2024-2026 plan. Project costs are estimates, not approved budgets or actual expenditure; 232 combines completed and ongoing, and no official evaluation or territorial crosswalk is inferred.

sources.title: Taiz Governorate Statistical Yearbook 2024, seventh edition
sources.reuse_note: New Taiz CSO branch 2024 yearbook location. AreaData acquired 314 pages and audited two 23-district tables; district sums exceed printed totals, sex labels conflict across pages and dashes mean unavailable. No district observation was adopted. Kit must resolve conflicts, official codes/boundary edition and terms.

sources.title: CSO governorate statistical yearbook catalogue
sources.reuse_note: New CSO location lists 2024 and older governorate statistical yearbooks. Individual files, table fields, geography and terms have not been audited or adopted by AreaData.

sources.title: IHSN archive of Yemen CSO 2004 census tables 1-3
geographic_levels: governorate where the original table reports it
sources.reuse_note: New IHSN archival location for three CSO-authored 2004 PDF tables, not the missing main report. Table 1 concerns dwellings; Tables 2-3 are employment sample tables aged 10+ and 15+, not whole-population census counts. Review all pages, 2004 administrative geography, reuse terms and original producer independently.
